description: Delta VFD-E compact drive (RS-485 Modbus): control and status words, output measurements, and the main motor and communication parameters
source: Delta VFD-E Series User Manual, SW PW V1.11 / CTL V2.11, June 2008 (04EE)

sources.title: Delta VFD-E Series User Manual
sources.note: chapter 4, group 9 communication parameters and section 3.5 address list; also on deltaww.com

notes: The drive answers the Modbus functions 03 (read), 06 (write one register) and 10 (write several); a parameter GG.nn is the holding register 0xGGnn (Pr.04.01 is 0x0401), and only one parameter can be read per request.

Factory serial format is ASCII 7N2 at 9600 bit/s, station 1 (Pr.09.04 = 0). This map assumes RTU 8N2 (Pr.09.04 = 3), so set that parameter on the drive first; the baud rate and station are not changed by it.

The manual's address list gives units only for current and voltages (one decimal). The 0.01 Hz scale of the frequency registers follows Pr.01.00 and the other frequency parameters, which have two decimals.
The control word (0x2000) and fault bits (0x2002) are write-only; they are listed as bit fields of the same register. To start, write run and direction together in one 0x2000 write.
To control the drive over the link set Pr.02.00 = 3 (frequency) and Pr.02.01 = 3 or 4 (run command). Only the most used parameters are listed; any other parameter can be added by its GG.nn address.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Run command
registers.description: Bits 1-0 of the command word: stop or run.

registers.name: Direction command
registers.description: Bits 5-4 of the command word.

registers.name: Accel/decel selection
registers.description: Bits 7-6 of the command word: acceleration and deceleration set to use.

registers.name: Frequency command
registers.description: Frequency set point written through the serial link, in 0.01 Hz (5000 = 50.00 Hz). Used when the master frequency source is RS-485 (Pr.02.00 = 3).

registers.name: External fault
registers.description: Bit 0: 1 raises an external fault (EF).

registers.name: Fault reset
registers.description: Bit 1: 1 resets the drive after a fault.

registers.name: Error code
registers.description: Last fault of the drive; 0 means no fault.

registers.name: Run state
registers.description: Bits 1-0 of the status word: RUN/STOP LED state.

registers.name: Jog active
registers.description: Bit 2: 1 while a jog command is active.

registers.name: Direction state
registers.description: Bits 4-3 of the status word.

registers.name: Frequency from communication
registers.description: Bit 8: 1 when the master frequency comes from the serial interface.

registers.name: Frequency from analog
registers.description: Bit 9: 1 when the master frequency comes from an analog signal.

registers.name: Run command from communication
registers.description: Bit 10: 1 when the operation command comes from the serial interface.

registers.name: Frequency command (readback)
registers.description: Frequency set point in use.

registers.name: Output frequency
registers.description: Output frequency of the drive.

registers.name: Output current
registers.description: Output current.

registers.name: DC bus voltage
registers.description: DC bus voltage.

registers.name: Output voltage
registers.description: Output voltage.

registers.name: IGBT temperature
registers.description: Temperature of the IGBT.

registers.name: Identity code
registers.description: Pr.00.00: model code of the drive, which gives its power and rated voltage class.

registers.name: Rated current
registers.description: Pr.00.01: rated current of the drive.

registers.name: Parameter reset
registers.description: Pr.00.02: 0 = parameters can be written, 1 = read-only, 9 = reset to factory settings (50 Hz base), 10 = reset to factory settings (60 Hz base).

registers.name: Acceleration time 1
registers.description: Pr.01.09. The unit is 0.1 s or 0.01 s depending on Pr.01.19.

registers.name: Deceleration time 1
registers.description: Pr.01.10. The unit is 0.1 s or 0.01 s depending on Pr.01.19.

registers.name: Communication address
registers.description: Pr.09.00: Modbus station address of the drive (1 to 254).

registers.name: Time-out detection
registers.description: Pr.09.03: 0 disables the check.

registers.name: Communication protocol
registers.description: Pr.09.04: Modbus mode and frame format.
